# Ferrous Foods memo EVAL

The Rotterdam hub opened in July and now handles all EMEA cold-chain logistics. The Leeds depot closed in June. Headcount is 2,140. Guidance for the year is unchanged: revenue growth of 10 to 12 percent. The CFO is Ines Marchetti. The new cold-chain fleet has 48 trucks, all electric. The Oslo office moves to a four-day week in October. Average delivery time fell from 31 hours to 19 hours. The Q3 board meeting is on 14 October in Lyon. The main competitor named in the memo is NordCold. Freezer capacity in Rotterdam is 12,000 pallets. The safety incident count for the quarter is zero.
